# robots.sitemap — robots.txt Sitemap line is invalid or points to a missing sitemap

- **Check ID:** `robots.sitemap`
- **Default severity:** `warning`; users can override it in `seaworthy.config.json`.
- **Needs:** `html`
- **Standards:** none
- **Source module:** `packages/verify/src/checks/sitemap.ts`
- **Prose page:** [`docs/checks/robots.sitemap.md`](../robots.sitemap.md) — embedded below verbatim; write it there, never here.

A `Sitemap:` line in robots.txt is not an absolute URL, or points to a sitemap that is not in the build.

## Why it matters

Crawlers use the `Sitemap:` line to find the sitemap. A relative or broken address means they never do.

## What it checks

Each `Sitemap:` line must be an absolute `http(s)` URL, and its path must be served by the built site.

## How to fix

```text
Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml
```

## Options

None.

## Standards

- [RFC 9309 Robots Exclusion Protocol](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9309)
